'''Char-An Commando Outpost''' was a [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] outpost located in the [[Deepest Woods]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], but the outpost was abandoned due to the negative mental effects of the area.
